investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Silverant Retail (online retail); Platform: AWS eu-west-1 (zones eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b/eu-west-1c); network range 10.84.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster silver-prod-euwest (EKS); inventory-svc is deployed with RollingUpdate (maxUnavailable 25%) and must run at full replica count during peak traffic; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
